question.text: Total return on long futures + cash =

answer.text: Equivalent to holding underlying physical asset

explanation.text: The Logic: Buying futures + keeping cash in bonds replicates long stock — synthetic position. The Trap: Unleveraged; works with margin + cash-collateral. Cross-Exam Context: VIII. Manager's Pro-Tip: Futures + T-bill = synthetic equity at lower transaction cost than physical stocks.
